name: 006-equity-index
title: Equity Index Sleeve (Robinhood execution, paper-first)
description: Stoic-style systematic equity index: rules allocate (cap-weight + momentum tilt + trim, monthly/drift bands), Jev narrates only. Paper sleeve first with zero new infra; broker executor, credential custody, and live trading only after paper beats its benchmark. Live capital IRA-housed; dedicated sub-account, scoped keys, spend caps, killswitch.
success_metrics: 90-day paper log beats holding the starting basket net of fees and estimated tax
Paper-vs-live tracking error tight for 90 days before any scale-up
Zero credential incidents; quarterly execution-path tests green
Live capital only in IRA sub-account with scoped key, spend cap, killswitch

venue.name: Robinhood equities/ETFs (incl. crypto-via-ETF) for execution; free public APIs for discovery math

verified_baseline.source: fee research 2026-10-09: $0 equity commission, regulatory dust on sells (SEC waived <$500), fractional from $1; crypto spot spread ~0.85% (rotation-prohibitive); ETF expense ~0.2-0.25%/yr; IRA 3% Gold match
verified_baseline.note: No paper evidence yet. This track starts at zero evidence; Stage 1 creates it with no new infrastructure.

constraints: Paper first: no broker executor code until the paper sleeve beats its benchmark
Rules allocate, Jev narrates only; Jev never sizes, triggers, or vetoes
Live capital IRA-housed (rotation is short-term-gains toxic in taxable)
Dedicated sub-account, scoped revocable keys, spend cap, killswitch; trade the sub-account, never the main
One strategy at a time per repo workflow; this track waits behind 004/005
Dashboard facts only: every number sourced + timestamped, HODL comparison mandatory
out_of_scope: crypto spot rotation on Robinhood (0.85% spread — prohibitive, stays on-chain or static)
options/futures/event contracts (per-contract fees punish small size)
margin trading (PDT + interest; cash account, monthly bands)
tax advice (track lots mechanically; CPA questions stay human)

as_is: 005 paper-log schema + graduation contract (evidence promotes, narrative doesn't)
005 gate framework style (pure functions + reason strings)
adapt: treasury/budget accounting extended to equity lots + friction tracking
funnel stages redefined for allocation (universe -> weighted -> band-trigger -> cost-bar -> filled)
rewrite: Broker executor (order-state machine: place/ack/fill/partial/cancel/reject, T+1 aware)
Session calendar (market hours, halts, corporate actions)
Credential custody (scoped keys, sub-account isolation, killswitch)
